'''''Second Film''''' is a 2018 superhero film.

===Box office===
''Second Film'' grossed $700.4&nbsp;million in the United States and Canada, and $649.5&nbsp;million in other territories, for a worldwide total of $1.350&nbsp;billion.<ref name="BOM" /> It became the 33rd film to surpass $1&nbsp;billion at the box office.<ref name="1B" /> Another critic preferred ''Third Film''{{'}}s $2.045&nbsp;billion worldwide gross at the time.<ref name="IGN" />

In its opening weekend, ''Second Film'' grossed $202&nbsp;million in the United States and Canada.<ref name="mojo" />
